provenance: Every WAV is computed by scripts/generate-v12-signature.ts from numeric parameters and seeded xorshift32 noise. No recordings, downloaded samples, SoundFonts, impulse responses, loops or third-party audio are read or embedded.
rateRule: playbackRate = 2^(semitones/12) relative to rootNote; pitch and duration change together (v0.7 has no time-stretch), so a source lasts seconds / playbackRate.

identity.lowEnd: SUB HAMMER (+4 cycles), IRON PULSE (+3), CONVERGENCE (+6) and REACTOR/ABYSS (zero phase) all settle on A1 = 55 Hz in phase: trigger any of them on the same tick and the fundamentals add instead of cancelling.

chrome.description: Minor-third bell (hum, prime, tierce, quint, nominal) plus eight inharmonic upper modes.

ghostVowel.description: Shared synthetic "oh" and "ah" formants [Hz, level, bandwidth Hz].

sounds.name: SUB HAMMER
sounds.role: Massive, tight, tuned kick: a 570 Hz strike falls to an A1 body that lands exactly in phase with ABYSS.
sounds.use: Four-on-the-floor or half-time downbeats; trigger with ABYSS on the same tick for one coherent low end; velocity 0.75–1.
sounds.articulation: Full tail for sparse grooves; gate "1/8" + releaseSeconds 0.04 for fast grooves; chokeGroup "kick" with IRON PULSE.
sounds.method: Two-stage exponential pitch drop with exactly four extra cycles (phase-locks to 55 Hz), biased tanh drive that relaxes after 50 ms, band-passed strike noise and a 1.85 kHz beater click; 4x oversampled.

sounds.name: IRON PULSE
sounds.role: Punchy, aggressive electronic kick: hard 1.3 kHz click, 150 Hz knock, short driven A1 body.
sounds.use: Driving drops and techno grooves; layer over SUB HAMMER (both phase-lock to A1) for weight plus punch; velocity 0.7–1.
sounds.articulation: Plays whole; for rolls use gate "1/32" + releaseSeconds 0.01; playbackRate 1.12–1.33 for a harder, shorter knock.
sounds.method: Pitch drop with exactly three extra cycles, 150 Hz knock mode, strong asymmetric drive plus a short wavefold, band-passed click and a CHROME-mode tick; 4x.

sounds.name: TITANIUM CRACK
sounds.role: Layered, impactful snare: A3 shell, two-stage wire noise, a hard crack and a short CHROME ring with side-only room.
sounds.use: Backbeats, half-time beat 3, rolls into drops (velocity ramps 0.35→1); stack with NEON CLAP for a wide drop snare.
sounds.articulation: Rolls: gate "1/32" + releaseSeconds 0.015; chokeGroup "snare" keeps fast rolls clean.
sounds.method: Pitch-dropping 220/351/470 Hz membrane modes, band-passed noise with fast and slow wire decays, high-passed crack, CHROME upper modes on A5, tanh glue, decorrelated diffused side tail.

sounds.name: NEON CLAP
sounds.role: Bright, textured electronic clap: five panned bursts and a tail rung through an A5 comb (the neon buzz).
sounds.use: Beats 2 and 4, layered with TITANIUM CRACK, or alone in breakdowns; playbackRate 0.84–0.94 for a darker, bigger clap.
sounds.articulation: Plays whole; gate "1/16" + releaseSeconds 0.03 tightens it for fast patterns.
sounds.method: Band-passed noise bursts at 0/7.1/15.8/24.9/33.6 ms with constant-power pans, a feedback comb tuned to 882 Hz inside the tail, decorrelated side tail; 4x.

sounds.name: GHOST TICK
sounds.role: Crisp, controlled closed hat: six square partials on CHROME ratios band-passed at 10 kHz, nothing below 5 kHz.
sounds.use: 1/16 grids with accent patterns (0.35/0.7), ghost notes at 0.2–0.3; shares chokeGroup "hats" with OPEN CIRCUIT.
sounds.articulation: Plays whole (90 ms audible); chokeGroup "hats" closes OPEN CIRCUIT.
sounds.method: Band-limited squares at 410 Hz x CHROME ratios, 10.2 kHz band-pass, four-pole 6.5 kHz high-pass, 12.5 kHz noise grain, two-stage 8.5/25 ms decay; 4x.

sounds.name: OPEN CIRCUIT
sounds.role: Expressive open hat: the same metal opening from 7.2 to 10.5 kHz with a long stereo shimmer.
sounds.use: Off-beat eighths in drops, one per bar in grooves; gate it musically, or let GHOST TICK choke it.
sounds.articulation: gate "1/8" + releaseSeconds 0.06 for a tight off-beat; chokeGroup "hats" with GHOST TICK.
sounds.method: GHOST TICK metal through a swept state-variable band-pass, per-channel noise, a 4.7 kHz ring-modulated sheen and a two-stage 20/280 ms decay; 4x.

sounds.name: ABYSS
sounds.role: Deep sustained sub-bass on A1 (55 Hz): clean sine body, 2nd–5th harmonic bloom at the onset, steady warm sustain.
sounds.use: Held roots and slow bass lines from E1 to F#2; pair with SUB HAMMER on shared onsets; duck it with gain automation under every kick.
sounds.articulation: gate = note length, envelope {attackSeconds 0.004, releaseSeconds 0.08}; offsetSeconds 0.12 skips the bloom for tied legato notes.
sounds.method: Additive sine with explicit sine-phase harmonics (bloom decays in 120 ms to −19/−26/−35 dB), slow 0.23 Hz second-harmonic breathing, 6 ms raised-cosine onset, 1.5 s end fade; zero start phase.

sounds.name: REACTOR
sounds.role: Aggressive, harmonically rich mid-bass on A1: driven saws plus FM growl through the ghost vowel, mono below 140 Hz.
sounds.use: Rolling 1/16 bass, off-beat stabs and held drop notes; alone it is a full bass, over ABYSS add a 90–120 Hz track high-pass.
sounds.articulation: Stabs: gate "1/16" + releaseSeconds 0.03; held: gate = note length, releaseSeconds 0.08; the first 60 ms are the bark.
sounds.method: Detuned band-limited saws, FM carrier with evolving index and a phase-locked A1 sine, tanh drive at 4x, oh→ah formant band-passes, resonant low-pass with a 20 ms bark and slow non-periodic breathing, mono crossover at 140 Hz.

sounds.name: SIGNAL
sounds.role: Hypnotic melodic synth on A4: a crisp digital pluck that keeps singing when held.
sounds.use: Arpeggios and ostinatos (A3–G5), call-and-response hooks, held notes up to 2.5 s at the top of its range.
sounds.articulation: Arps: gate "1/16" + releaseSeconds 0.04; held: gate = note length, releaseSeconds 0.15.
sounds.method: 1:2 FM with a decaying index, PWM pulse from two band-limited saws through an enveloped resonant low-pass, harmonic and inharmonic (4.21x) pings, ±3.5 cent stereo pair; 2x.

sounds.name: PHANTOM
sounds.role: Powerful, emotionally resonant lead on E5: seven-voice unison voiced by the ghost vowel; held notes bloom and grow vibrato.
sounds.use: The main hook from A4 to C6 (rates 0.67–1.59): short notes stay clean, notes over 0.5 s open up and sing.
sounds.articulation: gate = note length, envelope {attackSeconds 0.005, releaseSeconds 0.12}; slides by overlapping notes 1/32.
sounds.method: Seven band-limited saws (±19 cents, each drifting ±1.5 cents) with the centre three in both channels, sub-octave square, shared delayed 5.1 Hz vibrato, 1.4 s low-pass bloom with an attack bite, ghost-vowel formant peaks, soft drive, vowel-band breath noise; 2x.

sounds.name: EVENT HORIZON
sounds.role: Evolving, spacious open-fifth pad on A2 (A2 E3 A3 E4 A4): no third, so it fits minor and major chords.
sounds.use: Section beds and drones under any chord built on its root; swells in by 1.6 s; offsetSeconds 1.6 starts it at full level.
sounds.method: 222 additive partials with independent slow amplitude LFOs, drift detune, a travelling log-frequency spectral bump and rotating constant-power pans (partials below 220 Hz centred), plus noise rung through chord-tone resonators.

sounds.name: AFTERGLOW
sounds.role: Warm, cinematic single-note pad on A3: analog-style ensemble for building chords.
sounds.use: Stack three or four notes from C3 to E4 for chords; 0.28 s attack plays on the beat; sustains full bars.
sounds.method: Six band-limited saws (±11 cents) with independent slow drift, triangle core, breathing two-pole low-pass, gentle tanh warmth; voices alternate L/R.

sounds.name: SPECTER
sounds.role: Original synthetic vowel texture on A3: a three-voice androgynous choir that moves oo → oh → ah → oh → oo.
sounds.use: Held choir tones, chord tops, vowel chops (offsetSeconds 2.2–2.8 is the open "ah"), haunting intros.
sounds.articulation: gate = note length, envelope {attackSeconds 0.05, releaseSeconds 0.4}; chops: endSeconds + gate "1/8".
sounds.method: Additive glottal-tilt harmonics shaped by morphing four-formant envelopes (OO, ghost "oh"/"ah", EH), three detuned voices with independent delayed vibrato and formant scale, glottal-pulsed breath noise through the formants.

sounds.name: CHROME STRIKE
sounds.role: Distinctive metallic accent: the CHROME minor-third bell struck on A4, shimmering in stereo.
sounds.use: Phrase-end accents, the opening identity hit, melodic bell figures (it is tuned: hum A3, prime A4, tierce C5).
sounds.articulation: Plays whole; gate "1/4" + releaseSeconds 0.25 for rhythmic bell figures.
sounds.method: Twelve CHROME modes with ratio-dependent decays and L/R split partners, strike-position weighting, band-passed strike noise and a 2.38 kHz FM anvil tick.

sounds.name: ASCENSION
sounds.role: Musical tension riser: A–E fifths climbing exactly one octave to A4/E5, a rising noise sweep and accelerating flutter.
sounds.use: Ends at its last frame: place it 6 s before a downbeat, or use offsetSeconds (6 − build seconds) for shorter builds.
sounds.articulation: Plays whole; never gate it (the peak is the final frame).
sounds.method: Exponential one-octave glide on soft band-limited saws, swept state-variable band-pass noise (350 Hz → 9.7 kHz) with rising Q, CHROME shimmer, accelerating tremolo, widening side signal, 6 ms boundary taper.

sounds.name: CONVERGENCE
sounds.role: Powerful cinematic impact: A2→A1 sub drop (phase-locked), body thump, crack, an A minor stab and a long CHROME tail.
sounds.use: Section downbeats and finales; leave 3–5 s; pairs with ASCENSION ending on the same frame.
sounds.articulation: Plays whole; gate the tail with releaseSeconds 0.6 if the next section starts early.
sounds.method: Sub drop with exactly six extra cycles, band-passed noise thump, two-band crack, CHROME modes on A3 through per-channel allpass diffusion, low-passed A-minor saw stab, falling noise debris, mono below 140 Hz; 2x.
